about: Fifteen Days background plates: one per camera setup, from the grey-box sets (owner, 2026-10-16). Layout from the set render, look from the place's approved picture. Prompts DRAFTED by the coding agent.

jobs.prompt: An empty establishing background plate of the small open-air courtyard cafe at night, for wide, from the west. Reference image 1 is a plain grey 3D layout render: copy its camera position, height, angle, lens and perspective exactly, and where every wall, table, chair, railing, door and window stands, but draw nothing of its grey blocks, white background or simple figures as they are: turn them into the real, finished place. Reference image 2 shows how this place looks: its materials, colours, light and mood. None of the main characters are in the picture; any people are ordinary background figures in plain, muted everyday clothes, small and natural. Detailed science fiction comic art at night: precise fine uniform linework, cel-shaded flat color, a deep blue and violet night with glowing practical lights, pools of warm and cool light on faces and surfaces, crisp silhouettes, clear readable faces and hands. Wherever the sky shows, enormous megastructures and towering buildings fill the far distance and the horizon, their lit windows and beacons glowing against the night, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance. Another time and place, not the Earth we know: unfamiliar architecture, no recognisable landmarks, vehicles or brands. Shop fronts and walls carry no lettered signs at all: at most a plain glowing panel with one single large simple pictogram (a cup, a leaf, a bowl) and nothing else. Screens show only abstract shapes. No letters, words, digits or numbers anywhere. No text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers. No cartoon murals or cartoon animals, and nothing that resembles a known character.
